verdict.rationale: monday.com ships its own agents, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence, however, only documents monday acting as an MCP server: a hosted MCP URL, a developer MCP, and external agents from Claude or ChatGPT connecting into monday. Nothing shows users registering third-party MCP servers so monday's agents can call those servers' tools. Agent-skills and apps-framework items are developer building blocks rather than an MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.
